paragraphs: Count inventory and verify the cash drawer at the start of the shift. Exchange chips and make change after opening, counting each transaction in front of the patron. Work faster without sacrificing accuracy during peak lines, reconcile once with the cage at midday, then balance accounts, seal funds, and transfer them to the vault before leaving.
